dedupe_keys.name: dutch primary schools classroom indoor air quality sensor network post covid ventilation study

description: This dataset comes from a network of indoor air quality sensors in 252 classrooms of Dutch primary schools, used to measure how ventilation measures taken after COVID-19 changed classroom air. The sensors record carbon dioxide and other indoor climate readings through the school day, which the authors link to the ventilation guidance schools followed. The analysis appeared in PNAS Nexus in 2023 as The effect of post-COVID ventilation measures on indoor air quality in primary schools, and the data and code are on OSF and GitHub. Coverage: 252 classrooms in the Netherlands. Access: free from the public OSF project zrfst and the GitHub repository. Licence: none set on the OSF project; the article is CC BY. Caveats: low-cost sensors; school selection is not a random sample; reuse terms for the data are not stated. Simulation uses are calibrating classroom ventilation and airborne infection risk models, and school building retrofit and heat adaptation studies where carbon dioxide is a proxy for air change. Related records: the ASHRAE global thermal comfort database and the Danish six office rooms dataset.
